standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the image of an injective endomorphism a direct summand.

core_obligations: (1): an indecomposable injective module is the injective hull of each of its nonzero submodules, by uniqueness of hulls (proof lines 788-789)
(2): the intersection of two nonzero submodules is nonzero, which follows from (1) and the definition of an injective hull (proof lines 790-791)

(3): the endomorphisms with nonzero kernel form a two-sided ideal because the kernels of two such endomorphisms intersect nontrivially; an injective endomorphism has image a direct summand isomorphic to the module, hence is surjective by indecomposability, so the ring of endomorphisms is local (proof lines 792-806)
(4): the preimage of that maximal ideal is a prime and the module is injective over the corresponding localisation (proof lines 807-810)
proof_roadmap: (1)(2)：由内射壳的唯一性与定义直接得到。
(3)：令 A = End_R(E)、I = {φ : Ker φ ≠ 0}；两个非单射的核由 (2) 交非零 ⇒ I 是双边理想；φ ∉ I 时 φ(E) ≅ E 是内射子模 ⇒ 由不可分解性 E = φ(E) ⇒ φ 可逆 ⇒ A 是局部环。
(4)：R → A 的原像 p 是素理想，且 E 是 R_p-模；由内射性的相应引理得 E 在 R_p 上内射。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement describes the structure of an indecomposable injective module: it is the injective hull of each nonzero submodule, nonzero submodules meet, its endomorphism ring is local with the non-injective endomorphisms as the maximal ideal, and the zerodivisors on it form a prime ideal over which it stays injective (author lemma at source lines 774-786, label lemma-indecomposable-injective). The proof (source lines 788-811) uses uniqueness of injective hulls for the first two assertions and runs the local-ring argument for the third, ending with the prime ideal and the injectivity over the localisation (proof lines 788-810). The local endomorphism ring argument is the substance. H3.
